**Finding resubmitted: Compliant** — no redline, no counterparty comment.

What changed in the repair:

- **Quote swapped** to p0061 (the No Joint Venture clause), the only paragraph in the document containing the word "employee." Quoting the text I *ruled out* evidences the absence more directly than quoting the exclusivity covenants did.
- **Paragraph set expanded** to p0037, p0042, and p0061 so the record covers every employee-adjacent and "shall not" paragraph considered.
- **Rationale now addresses the two failed checks head-on**: the 12-month duration and general-solicitation carve-out tests probe attributes that can only exist *inside* a non-solicit clause. With no such clause present, there is nothing to shorten and nothing to qualify. Adding a carve-out would mean first drafting the restrictive covenant it modifies — importing a restriction on us that HDI never sought and moving us away from the preferred position.

The substantive conclusion is unchanged and matches the verifier's own reading: the Section 6 covenants (p0037, p0042) restrict participation in competing Internet projects for Deerskin Products, not the solicitation or hiring of staff, so no non-solicit or no-hire binds us as Customer.

The p0037 exclusivity restriction on us remains flagged for review under the applicable exclusivity/non-compete rule, including the duration asymmetry — HDI's mirror covenant at p0042 runs for the term plus two years and survives under Section 10.7, while ours is term-only.
